turns.text: I think I have 2 UTR names and therefore need to merge. How do I do this?

Got it — you have two UTR profiles that need to be merged. I can help you with that.

Are these profiles both yours, or are they for someone else (like a child or a player you coach)?
Both mine. How can I check?

You can check by logging into your UTR account and looking at your profile. If you see two separate profiles under your name, those are your duplicates.

Do you have the links to both of your profiles, or at least the display names and locations for each? That's what I'll need to get this started.
One of the profiles is under Renae Aron-Dawson, and the other might be under Renae Aron or Renae Dawson

Thanks for that. To find the exact profiles, you can search UTR for each of those names and note the locations (city/state) for each one — that'll help our team identify them correctly.

Once you have the profile links (or the display name and location for each), let me know both, and also which one you'd like to keep as your primary profile.
Okay, thanks
You're welcome! Once you've found both profiles and have the links (or names and locations), just come back and share them along with which one you want to keep, and I'll get this submitted for you.
can i request aprofile merge
Yes, I can help with a profile merge request. Are the profiles yours, your child’s, a player you manage, or someone else’s?
yes
Which best describes the profiles: yours, your child’s, a player you manage, or someone else’s?
mine
Please send both profile links— the one you want to keep as primary and the one to merge. If you don’t have links, send the display name and location for each.
Thomas Giraldo with https://app.utrsports.net/profiles/5733502
Which profile should be kept as primary? Please also send the other profile’s link, or its display name and location.
https://app.utrsports.net/profiles/5926601 keep this one as primary with the login info of the first one

I have profile 5926601 as the one to keep and profile 5733502 as the one to merge. I’ll include your request to keep the first profile’s login information, though I can’t guarantee what can be changed. What email is on your UTR account?
[email]

I have your profiles as yours: keep Thomas Giraldo’s profile at https://app.utrsports.net/profiles/5926601 and merge https://app.utrsports.net/profiles/5733502, keeping the login information associated with the first profile. Your name is Thomas Giraldo, and your account email is [email]. I’ll send this to the team now — reply send, or add anything you’d like included.
ook
Can I link my usta and UTR account?
Do you mean connecting your accounts, or getting your USTA match results to appear on your UTR profile?
Yes
Which do you mean: connecting the accounts, or adding USTA match results to your UTR profile?
Yes
Which one would you like help with: **1)** connecting the accounts, or **2)** getting USTA match results on your UTR profile?
I don't have details on a way to directly link a USTA account to UTR. Are you trying to get your USTA match results to appear on your UTR profile?
Yes
USTA results are imported daily and usually appear within about 24 hours of USTA posting them. When did USTA post the result, and what tournament or league was it from?
Arora tennis
When did USTA post the Arora Tennis result? If you have a link to the published result, please share it too.
